name: Ordering
description: Restore an order from comparisons: who stands behind whom, who is older or taller.

name: Knights and liars
description: Knights always tell the truth and liars always lie; decide which statements are true and who said them.

name: Enumeration
description: Count all possible options: handshakes, simple routes described in words, numbers made of given digits.

name: Gaps and boundaries
description: Count gaps versus objects: saw cuts in a log, trees in a row, floors of a building.

name: Clocks
description: Differences between times of day and how long something lasts.

name: Calendar and age
description: Shifting days of the week, dates, ages in a few years.

name: Pigeonhole principle
description: The simplest pigeonhole arguments: how many socks to take out in the dark to be sure of a pair.

name: Parity and alternation
description: Properties of even and odd numbers, alternation in a sequence of objects or moves.

name: Arithmetic with a trick
description: A convenient order of operations instead of long computation, "I thought of a number" puzzles.

name: Weighing and pouring
description: Plan a short sequence of weighings on a balance or pourings between jugs to reach a goal.
